scoring_justification: Only a single JSON artifact with final numeric results; no raw intermediate artifact exists to recompute performance metrics from. The strongest feasible tier is a result-level comparison (T0) against the paper-reported gold values. Tolerance of 5% accounts for round-off and unit conversions.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for actuator static performance
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's reported numbers in Section VII.A and VII.B: electromagnetic max force 0.15 mN, driving range 1.25 mm; piezoelectric max force 12 mN, max displacement 0.9×10⁻³ mm.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's quantitative evaluation text and converted to SI units (N, m).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numeric results reported by the authors in the paper for the given dimensions and material constants.

outputs.description: Static force and displacement metrics for electromagnetic and piezoelectric microactuators.

output_contract.notes: The output file contains four numeric fields: electromagnetic maximum force in Newtons, electromagnetic driving range in meters, piezoelectric maximum force in Newtons, and piezoelectric maximum displacement in meters.
